title: EstimateFairPriceResult
description: Checkpoint C.2.1 success-result contract for the estimate_fair_price MCP tool. Reuses the existing FairPriceEstimate object by $ref (never duplicated field-by-field), the same way SearchStaysResult.$defs.resultItem does, pinned to exactly schema_version 1.1.0 with interval required -- the same rules apply for the same reasons (docs/adr/0003-phase2-checkpoint-c0-serving-contract.md §7/§9). Every field here is either a fixed snapshot fact, a model output, or a deterministic Python computation -- never a live-availability or booking claim, exactly like search_stays.

provenance.description: The same manifest-derived historical provenance every search_stays result item carries -- never request execution time.

disclaimer.description: Fixed, server-authored snapshot-data disclaimer -- the same text and the same truthfulness rule as SearchStaysResult.disclaimer.

fair_price.description: FairPriceEstimate pinned to exactly schema_version 1.1.0, with interval required -- identical tightening to SearchStaysResult.$defs.resultItem.fair_price, not a separate parallel shape.
